commands:
set -euo pipefail
BRANCH=work/photomap-straighten-20260912
REMOTE_BASE=24b8c780834c77a9ff779f38880cca6aac0650a9
LOCAL_FIX=e1fd4a8
git fetch origin "$BRANCH"
test "$(git rev-parse origin/$BRANCH)" = "$REMOTE_BASE"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
test "$(git rev-parse --short=7 HEAD)" = "$LOCAL_FIX"
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('frontend/src/components/admin/AdminPhotoGalleryModal.test.tsx')
text = p.read_text()
old = '        currentPhotoId="photo-1"\n        isSettingCover={false}'
new = '        currentPhotoId="photo-1"\n        isReviewing={false}\n        isSettingCover={false}'
if text.count(old) != 1:
    raise SystemExit(f'expected exactly one gallery test insertion point, got {text.count(old)}')
p.write_text(text.replace(old, new))
PY
git diff --check
git add frontend/src/components/admin/AdminPhotoGalleryModal.test.tsx
git commit -m 'Update gallery test for review lock'
NEW_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
VENV=$(mktemp -d /tmp/photomap-place-photo-review-113-XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$VENV"; ./scripts/devctl.sh stop >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
python3 -m venv "$VENV"
"$VENV/bin/python" -m pip install -q -r backend/requirements.txt
cd frontend
npm run lint
npm run build
npm run test -- src/components/admin/AdminPhotoGalleryModal.test.tsx
PYTHON="$VENV/bin/python" npm run test:e2e -- e2e/visual/admin-place-photo-review-lock.spec.ts e2e/visual/admin-media-mutation-lock.spec.ts e2e/visual/admin.spec.ts --project=chromium --grep-invert 'visual:'
cd ..
git diff --check
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
git push origin HEAD:"$BRANCH"
git fetch origin "$BRANCH"
test "$(git rev-parse origin/$BRANCH)" = "$NEW_SHA"
printf 'published_sha=%s\n' "$NEW_SHA"
trap - EXIT
rm -rf "$VENV"
./scripts/devctl.sh stop >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
